pr_title: Allow ruleset to specify custom names for bonus/tick types
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/10353
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/10422

This change allows rulesets to specify custom names. It also gives rulesets the chance to expose all used result types, so we can better display zero-counts.

Bit of a large PR but it's all quite related logic. Could split the display portion out but doesn't seem worthwhile (commits should be pretty easy to review as they make isolated changes).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/95301168-2e158180-08bb-11eb-86e5-8622a96644f4.png)

As an aside, `ScorePanel` layout is a huge point of pain. I found a solution this time, but also hope to not have to make any more hacks around that code.
pr_comments: Please pay special attention to the per-ruleset specs, since that was a manual addition and i'm only 99% sure I got everything correct.

Mod display overflows.
![dotnet_GtWeKFfPWM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/95520554-66c95f80-097c-11eb-8a9d-58278c632616.png)

Edit: was an issue already (https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/10422)

issue_context.title: Contracted score panel is no longer high enough to display mods when all judgements are shown
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** With the addition of `L` and `S` ticks to the score, the design for the contracted panel is no longer high enough to show everything at the same time (mods specifically).

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
- This is how the panel looks like with `Great`, `OK`, `Meh`, `Miss`, `L Tick` and `S Tick` (in this example, you can't see the mods)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/95459159-890aaf80-0973-11eb-889e-bd699bbb68b3.png)

- Mods used:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/95459185-9162ea80-0973-11eb-9977-ec13ea2610bf.png)

**osu!lazer version:** 2020.1005.0

review_comments:
Given that this was sort of a workaround already for the fact that we couldn't tell which results are valid for which ruleset (see description of #10251), maybe this should be now replaced by `Ruleset.GetHitResults()` entirely? Even more so that `TopScoreStatisticsSection` also does that indirectly via `GetStatisticsForDisplay()`.

Another thing, the table can look a tad cramped now:

![2020-10-07-194525_610x152_scrot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20418176/95370817-a7bc6800-08d9-11eb-8c52-23b12d05b45a.png)

i actually have this stashed. it doesn't work well with the way we are getting scores from the API (the new types are never populated and, as you saw, make the table impossibly cramped).

probably best as a separate effort.

OK, how about making the columns a little wider or allowing text wrap, though? Currently osu! and catch score tables look wrong as shown above due to overlapping header text. The max width of 60 set a few lines below is not enough for the text to always fit now.
Those columns shouldn't be displaying though... did I miss something?
They are because of the `IsBonus()` guard removal in `ScoreInfo`, in 6ac7094.

right... i didn't realise they were somehow included even though not returned by the api.

will look at removing them.
